scheme_name: Scheme for Providing (Golden Jubilee) One Time Grant-In-Aid in Memory of Blessed Mother Tereza
other_conditions: Institution/NGO must be registered with the state government registration authorities
Must have been in existence for a minimum period of 5 years
Must have provided humanitarian service to at least 25 inmates (old, sick, under‑privileged children, etc.) for the last 5 years
Must have infrastructure facilities of at least 50 sq. mts with proper ventilation, toilet, kitchen, etc.
Must furnish a copy of the constitution/bye‑laws of the institution
Application must be submitted using the prescribed proforma

For enhanced grants, a specific proposal supported by proper documentation must be submitted, restricted to the institution’s area of operations and related to upliftment of under‑privileged children, sick, aged, disabled, or destitute persons
Total grants under the scheme shall not exceed ₹1,00,00,000 per institution
benefits_summary: A one‑time grant of up to ₹25 lakhs is provided to selected institutions/NGOs, with additional or enhanced grants possible up to a total of ₹1 crore per institution as determined by the selection committee.
documents_required: All mandatory supporting documents as specified in the application form (self‑attested if required)
